turns.text: Hey Lloyd, can you help me pick a book for my team's monthly book club? We want something on complex systems and feedback loops.
Sure! Are there specific authors or styles you prefer? Or should I look for highly-rated introductory texts?
Just go with Thinking in Systems. I rate it 10/10 and consider it required reading.
Understood. I'll prioritize that title for the recommendation.
Also, quick check: did that package with the monitor stand arrive yet?
The tracking info says it's out for delivery and should be there by 5 PM today.
Nice. Anyway, back to the book. Just draft a short intro paragraph for the newsletter recommending it.
Got it. I'll draft an enthusiastic intro highlighting its value as a foundational text for the team.
